# 已經 + … + 喇 · *ji5 ging1 + … + laa3*

**Meaning:** already · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Time and aspect

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fji5-ging1-already).

已經 goes before the verb, and the sentence usually ends with 喇 to mark the new situation.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我已經食咗飯喇。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 ji5 ging1 sik6 zo2 faan6 laa3. |
| Yale | ngóh yíh gīng sihk jó faahn la. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄧ⁵ ㄍㄧㄥ¹ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄗㄛ² ㄈㄚㄣ⁶ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | I've already eaten. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢已經走咗喇。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2 laa3. |
| Yale | kéuih yíh gīng jáu jó la. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄧ⁵ ㄍㄧㄥ¹ ㄗㄜㄨ² ㄗㄛ² ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | He's already left. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **已經十點喇，快啲啦！** |
| Jyutping | ji5 ging1 sap6 dim2 laa3, faai3 di1 laa1! |
| Yale | yíh gīng sahp dím la, faai dī lā! |
| Bopomofo | ㄧ⁵ ㄍㄧㄥ¹ ㄙㄜㆴ⁶ ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄌㄚ³, ㄈㄚㄧ³ ㄉㄧ¹ ㄌㄚ¹! |
| English | It's already ten o'clock — hurry up! |
